context: Decide the intended contract first: either the guard recognizes an ephemeral/CI clone directly (no sibling worktree pool present, or an explicit signal such as CI), or BENCHBOX_AGENT_PRIMARY_CLONE becomes the documented supported path for these sessions and the refusal message names it alongside worktree-claim. Either way the refusal must keep firing unchanged in a real primary clone, and the message should stop implying BENCHBOX_ALLOW_MAIN_CLONE_WRITE is the only way out. Extend tests/unit/test_agent_write_preflight.py, which already covers the reject/allow/worktree cases.
description: scripts/agent_write_preflight.sh refuses whenever the working tree is not a linked worktree: it derives primary_clone from dirname(git rev-parse --git-common-dir) and rejects when that equals the toplevel. In a remote/ephemeral session (Claude Code on the web, CI, any container) the repo is a plain fresh clone, so the guard fires even though there is no primary clone to protect - the machinery it protects, and the pool it tells you to use, live on the maintainer's Mac. Its remedy 'make worktree-claim BRANCH=...' cannot work there: the pool targets sibling BenchBox.pool-NN directories that do not exist in a container. The only escape the message offers is BENCHBOX_ALLOW_MAIN_CLONE_WRITE=1, documented for 'emergency main-clone hotfix work' needing explicit user authorization. That is semantically wrong for a container session and actively harmful as habit: it trains agents to reach for the broad override routinely, which erodes the guard in the one place it does matter. Note a targeted escape already exists and is untested for this case - BENCHBOX_AGENT_PRIMARY_CLONE (agent_write_preflight.sh:15) repoints the comparison without granting main-clone write - so the fix may be detection plus documentation rather than a new knob. Encountered while opening PR #1374 from a container, where the guard blocked 'make pr-open'.

preserves.behavior: A real primary clone still refuses without an override, and the existing BENCHBOX_ALLOW_MAIN_CLONE_WRITE escape keeps working

work_units.evidence: Contract decided: an explicit BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE=1 declaration, honored ONLY when no worktree pool is present (git worktree list == 1 and no *.pool-* sibling). Rejected pure auto-detection: nothing on disk distinguishes a container clone from a real primary clone, and gating on pool-absence alone would silently disable the guard on the maintainer's Mac after a worktree-pool-reset.
